description: Sets a column's value by composing a string from a source template, then optionally applying a regex-replace to that intermediate string.

sourceTemplate.description: The format string for the source. Use placeholders matching column names, e.g., '{name}/{id}' or just '{path}'.

pattern.description: Optional. A regex pattern to apply to the intermediate string generated by 'sourceTemplate'.

replacement.description: Optional. The replacement string, used only if 'pattern' is provided. Use '$1', '$2', etc. (e.g., '$2-group-$1'). If 'pattern' is set but this is not, it will default to '$1' (extraction).

onMatchFailure.description: Action if 'pattern' is provided but does not match.

onMissingValue.description: Action if any column in 'sourceTemplate' is null/undefined.
